text.tspan: bot analyze TICKER ... or --from-screen
value each company by discounted cash flow (DCF), one report set per ticker
which tickers?
tickers given: those
--from-screen: passed candidates of the latest screener_candidates run
(newest created_at), by rank
no run, or no passed candidate: exit code 2
which override file?
--override path (only with exactly one ticker); not a file: exit code 2
else config/assumptions/TICKER.yaml when it exists, else none
read after the company is loaded, before the signals
any invalid file: cannot value, exit code 1, and the batch goes on
not valid YAML, not a mapping, an unknown key,
a numeric value that is not a finite number (or a non-empty list of them for revenue_growth / operating_margin),
a founded_year that is not a whole year from 1600 to this year,
or an inconsistent story file
config/currencies.yaml, risk-free rate and nominal gross domestic product (GDP) growth per currency
absent or malformed: empty table, every currency uncovered
a rate out of range: the command stops with an error

g.text: 2. story type: first rule that matches wins
3. assumptions: the first source that yields a value wins; paths over 10 years, growth fading to terminal growth
6. narrative flags: five checks, three more for hypergrowth; for a human, not in any ranking

Execution order, not dependency: the margin of safety and the verdict read the value after the governance discount and the latest close; the sanity check reads the latest close, net income, diluted shares and revenue, the discounted cash flow's intrinsic value per share and enterprise value, and the sector multiples. The flags change none of them, and the sanity check does not read the verdict.
unknown ticker, or no annual financials: exit code 2
bad arguments (tickers with --from-screen, neither, --override without exactly one ticker, an --override path that is not a file): exit code 2
the batch goes on after a failure
the command exits with the worst code
No incoming edge: the entry point, run by scripts/weekly.sh after bot screen, or by hand.

text.tspan: load the company
companies row (name, country, currency, industry_damodaran, ipo_date)
the newest non-restated financials_annual row
oldest-first revenue, net income and
earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) histories,
empty years dropped
newest prices_daily close, its currency and date
sector pe, ev_sales, op_margin, beta_levered
from the newest damodaran_industry row
of (industry, region)
valuation currency = currency of that newest non-restated row
close converted into the valuation currency when they differ:
rate_to_usd of both currencies, from currencies,
nearest on or before the close's date
dataset region
China, India, Japan: their own dataset region
else from the country's grouping in its newest damodaran_country row
unknown: US
derived signals
net debt = total debt − cash, a missing term counts as 0;
both missing: net debt taken as 0 in the DCF
interest coverage = EBIT ÷ interest expense;
empty when EBIT is missing, or interest expense is 0 or missing
age = whole years since ipo_date
founded age = this year − founded_year (override file), for the hypergrowth rule only
cyclical sector = industry_damodaran in the cyclical list (exact match)
hypergrowth: last-year growth ≥ 50%, compound annual growth rate (CAGR) ≥ 40%, margin below sector, founded ≤ 15 years ago or unknown
both margins known; fewer than two years, or the last or previous revenue ≤ 0: not hypergrowth
founded age = this year − founded_year of the override file

g.text: distressed: Altman Z < 1.81 or interest coverage ≤ 1.0

text.tspan: cyclical: cyclical sector and coefficient of variation ≥ 0.50
coefficient of variation = standard deviation ÷ |mean| of net income
(population standard deviation; fewer than 2 years or mean 0: not cyclical)
high-growth: revenue compound annual growth rate (CAGR) ≥ 15% and age ≤ 25 years
where CAGR = (last ÷ first)^(1 ÷ (years − 1)) − 1
unknown age counts as young
fewer than 2 years, or first or last ≤ 0: mature-stable
story_type in the override file?
yes: it replaces the classifier's story type
an unknown label: logged, and no story branch applies to the assumptions
hypergrowth only with a story file
classifier hypergrowth, no story type and no story section in the override file: high-growth, and a red hypergrowth_story flag
story type hypergrowth needs a story section

g.text: Gap: plano assumptions card lists six sources without story_pattern, and plano a-growth says the default is the historical average; a high-growth company with history gets the story_pattern path.

text.tspan: hypergrowth story: the story file shapes the ten-year paths
growth: year 1, then one solved rate up to year 5 so year-10 revenue meets the target, then a fade to terminal growth
margin, weighted average cost of capital (WACC), tax: from the story file
each path covers 10 years; the generic chain runs first for every company

also from the story: sales-to-capital, cost of equity = wacc_start (equity weight 1, debt weight 0), bankruptcy odds = failure_probability (0 by default), terminal return on invested capital (ROIC), proceeds share, fixed commitments, extra cash, governance discount; all sourced story
kept with their own source: terminal growth, the marginal tax rate (manual, sector, country, or 25%), pre-tax cost of debt, distress value per share
sector row: newest damodaran_industry row
for (industry, region)
none: the newest row of that industry in any region
sector label = sector_default_damodaran,
or sector_default_damodaran_cross_region
when another region's row is used
revenue growth g_t, a path over 10 years, fading in a straight line to the terminal growth (resolved first)
1. manual: a list keeps its length, no fade; one value is repeated 10 years → manual
2. no terminal growth: unresolved
3. from the historical growth (CAGR) → story_pattern for high-growth, historical_average otherwise
4. no history: from nominal GDP growth of the valuation currency → rule_based; no GDP either: unresolved
historical growth = revenue CAGR = (last ÷ first)^(1 ÷ (years − 1)) − 1,
at least two years, first and last > 0
operating margin, a 10-year path
1. manual → manual
2. high-growth with a latest EBIT ÷ revenue: straight line from it
to the sector op_margin → story_pattern
3. cyclical with ≥ 4 years: mean of the yearly
EBIT ÷ revenue → historical_average
4. sector op_margin each year → sector label
no sector op_margin: unresolved
sales-to-capital: manual → manual;
sector sales_to_capital → sector label; else unresolved
cost of equity and pre-tax cost of debt, each:
manual → manual; sector cost_of_equity / cost_of_debt
→ sector label; else unresolved
equity and debt weights
1. manual: one given, the other = 1 − it;
both given must sum to 1, else cannot value → manual
2. sector debt-to-equity (D/E): debt weight = D/E ÷ (1 + D/E),
equity weight = 1 − debt weight → sector label
3. else unresolved
terminal growth g_terminal
1. manual → manual
2. valuation currency in config/currencies.yaml:
min(risk-free rate, nominal GDP growth) of that currency → rule_based
3. uncovered currency: unresolved, so the DCF cannot run
tax rate
1. manual → manual
2. sector tax_rate → sector label
3. country tax_rate (newest damodaran_country row)
→ sector_default_damodaran
4. else 25% → rule_based
probability of bankruptcy p and distress value per share
manual → manual; else 0 → rule_based

g.text: The source label of each value:
story_pattern: a path built for the story type
story: the story file of a hypergrowth company
sector_default_damodaran: the sector or country row of the company's region
sector_default_damodaran_cross_region: the sector row of another region
rule_based: a fixed rule or default
unresolved: no source, so the company cannot be valued

text.tspan: can it be valued?
latest revenue present,
no assumption unresolved, sales-to-capital > 0
no: cannot value, exit code 1
weighted average cost of capital (WACC)
= equity weight × cost of equity + debt weight × pre-tax cost of debt × (1 − tax)
g_terminal < WACC?
no: cannot value, exit code 1
for t = 1 … N (N = length of the growth path, 10 unless a manual list differs, 10 with a story;
the margin path is cut, or extended with its last value, to N)
revenue_t = revenue_t−1 × (1 + g_t), revenue_0 = latest revenue
EBIT_t = revenue_t × margin_t
net operating profit after tax (NOPAT)_t = EBIT_t × (1 − tax)
reinvestment_t = (revenue_t − revenue_t−1) ÷ sales-to-capital
free cash flow to the firm (FCFF)_t = NOPAT_t − reinvestment_t
present value_t = FCFF_t ÷ (1 + WACC)^t
with a WACC path: present value_t = FCFF_t × the cumulative discount factor
with a story: NOPAT_t uses the story's yearly tax rate
terminal year N + 1: revenue = revenue_N × (1 + g_terminal), margin_N
FCFF_N+1 by the same formulas
terminal value = FCFF_N+1 ÷ (WACC − g_terminal)
present value of terminal value = terminal value ÷ (1 + WACC)^N
with a terminal return on invested capital (ROIC): reinvestment = NOPAT_N+1 × g ÷ ROIC
with a WACC path: WACC = the last year's, discounted by the last cumulative factor
enterprise value (EV) = Σ present value_t + present value of terminal value
terminal value share = present value of terminal value ÷ EV
(0 when EV = 0)
equity = EV − net debt + adjustments
going-concern value per share = equity ÷ diluted shares
with a story: − fixed commitments + extra cash
intrinsic value per share = (1 − p) × going-concern value per share
+ p × distress value per share
with a hypergrowth story: blended on EV before the bridge (proceeds share 0 by default), then the bridge
tornado: each axis × 0.8 and × 1.2, one at a time
axes: revenue_growth, operating_margin (every year scaled), tax_rate,
sales_to_capital, terminal_growth, cost_of_equity, pretax_cost_of_debt
swing = |intrinsic value at × 1.2 − intrinsic value at × 0.8|, widest first
an end with g_terminal ≥ WACC: no value, ranked last
with a WACC path: pretax_cost_of_debt is skipped; cost_of_equity scales the whole path
tax_rate scales tax_rate_path too
five by five grid on the two widest tornado axes
multipliers 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 on each
cell = intrinsic value ÷ price in the valuation currency (margin of safety); no price, or price ≤ 0: intrinsic value
a cell with g_terminal ≥ WACC: empty
scenario range, base first, then each scenario in file order
one plain DCF each; only with scenarios in the story file
a scenario that cannot be built, or whose g_terminal ≥ WACC: cannot value, exit code 1
story margin
story type not high-growth: green
company or sector margin missing: unknown
company EBIT ÷ revenue (latest year) > sector op_margin: yellow
else green
growth funded by reinvestment
any year with FCFF < 0, or reinvestment > 0 with NOPAT ≤ 0: red
highest reinvestment ÷ NOPAT over the years with NOPAT > 0
is > 0.90: yellow
else green
beta vs business risk
sector beta_levered < 1.0
and operating leverage > 1.5
and company debt weight > 40%: yellow
one of the three missing: unknown; else green
operating leverage = %ΔEBIT ÷ %ΔRevenue, last two years
(none when a base is 0, or revenue is unchanged)
company debt weight = total debt ÷ (total debt + total equity)
terminal value share > 80%: yellow
else green
country exposure
foreign revenue share > 50% and weighted equity risk premium (ERP)
− listing-country ERP > 300 bps: red
an input missing: unknown; else green
hypergrowth flags
hypergrowth_story: red with signals and no story file, yellow with a story file and no signals, green otherwise
revenue scale: year-10 revenue > 750B: yellow
terminal ROIC > 2 × the sector ROIC: yellow
a ROIC missing, or sector ROIC ≤ 0: unknown
run only with hypergrowth signals or the hypergrowth story type; revenue scale and terminal ROIC only with the hypergrowth story type

g.text: Only growth_reinvestment can be red among the five checks: three stop at yellow and country exposure is always unknown. Among the hypergrowth flags, only hypergrowth_story can be red (signals without a story file).

text.tspan: governance discount
value after governance = intrinsic value per share × (1 − governance discount)
the story's discount, else none; tornado, grid and scenarios keep the raw value
margin of safety (MoS) = intrinsic value per share ÷ latest close
with a governance discount: the value after governance ÷ latest close
latest close = newest close, in the valuation currency:
close × rate_to_usd of its currency ÷ rate_to_usd of the valuation currency
either currency unknown, or the same: the close as is
no close, no exchange rate (a missing or non-positive rate), or price ≤ 0: none
verdict
MoS ≥ 1.3: potentially undervalued
MoS ≥ 1.0: around fair value
MoS < 1.0: potentially overvalued
no MoS: n/a
implied multiples, from the DCF, next to the sector's; decides nothing
implied price-to-earnings (P/E) = intrinsic value per share ÷ earnings per share (EPS),
with EPS = net income ÷ diluted shares; market P/E = price ÷ EPS;
both need net income > 0, shares > 0 and EPS > 0;
implied P/E needs intrinsic value > 0, market P/E a price; both vs sector pe
implied EV ÷ sales = EV ÷ revenue, revenue > 0; vs sector ev_sales
markdown report from analysis.md.j2, eight sections:
1. executive summary (intrinsic value, and the value after governance when a discount is set), 2. story type + auto-assignment reasons,
3. assumptions (story inputs sourced story), 4. DCF detail, 5. sensitivity (with the scenario range), 6. narrative flags,
7. manual overrides, 8. sanity check vs sector multiples
HTML report: the markdown report plus the tornado chart
and the grid heatmap, inlined, no external assets
JSON sidecar: schema_version 1, generated_on, verdict,
the whole analysis

g.text: The sector multiples here (sanity check, flags) take the company's own dataset region only; the assumptions use the cross-region fallback.

Gap: the high-growth rule still reads age from ipo_date, which only Financial Modeling Prep fills. Verified: the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis, and Retrieval (EDGAR) parser parse_submissions_info always sets ipo_date to none, so under the default provider that age is unknown and every company counts as young. The hypergrowth rule reads founded_year of the override file instead (architecture decision record (ADR) 0009 (Implemented)).

Gap: Altman Z is read by the classifier but computed nowhere, and analyze never passes it; only interest coverage can make a company distressed. The plano s-ds and a-default cards say Altman Z decides it.
The report gives the reasons: revenue CAGR over the years, the age, the classifier's story type; with an override, a line naming what the classifier would have said.
Decided in ADR 0009 (Implemented): the hypergrowth story is driven by the story file.
Gap: spec §7.3 starts revenue growth from analyst consensus converging to nominal GDP by year 10; there is no consensus layer (AssumptionSource has no analyst_consensus).
Gap: spec §7.1 varies reinvestment by story type (high early for high-growth, minimal for mature-decline); sales-to-capital and terminal growth follow the same rule for every story type.
Gap: spec §7.3 builds the discount rate from the company's capital structure and the country equity risk premium; the code uses the sector's D/E and the sector cost of equity.
Gap: spec §7.3 derives the probability of bankruptcy of a distressed company from its rating or Altman Z; p and the distress value only come from a manual override, otherwise both are 0.
Gap: spec §7.2 and the plano dcf card adjust equity for minority interests and cross-holdings; adjustments has no input path (not filled by the pipeline, not an override key), so it is always 0.
Gap: analyze never supplies the foreign revenue share or the two ERPs (no ingest path has revenue by geography), so this flag is always unknown.
Gap: plano reports card says each report header carries the data versions it used; the header carries the generation date, currency and country only.
